ns2:section.sectionText: You just need to register for this one section if you would like to take this course online- You do NOT need to register for a discussion and lecture section for this online summer course as they are combined. Accountancy course prerequisites are strictly enforced. The Accounting Department will not allow students to advance in the accounting curriculum if they have not met the required prerequisite for previous accountancy courses taken. This section has one or more proctored evening exams, which may carry additional fees.
